subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/generator:hsd_8039D3AC

subjects.naming_decision: Keep canonical symbols and seven descriptive function-name hypotheses; no new aliases. Remove hypotheses mean retirement requests. Clear section alias.

subjects.naming_decision: Keep canonical symbols and seven descriptive function-name hypotheses; no new aliases. Remove hypotheses mean retirement requests. Clear section alias.
